description: Lead times for long-lead data centre equipment in the Indian market. Long-lead gear usually drives RFS (DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 4), so these numbers land directly on the critical path.
provenance_summary: !!! EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS INVENTED BY THE MODEL. !!! No vendor quotation, no purchase order, no historical project informed any of it. They are plausible-looking placeholders that exist so the engine has a shape to instance, and they must be replaced with real procurement data before any plan built on them is shown to a client. Because lead time drives RFS, a wrong number here silently produces a wrong completion date that looks fully researched. Decision point dp.long_lead_unconfirmed exists precisely to stop the simulator from using these unchallenged.
units: calendar weeks, ex-works to site delivery
